answer: Rate-limit identity creation and demand proof of unique personhood. Each new agent must pass a fresh liveness check tied to one real person, and only a few identities may be created per person per epoch, so no bulk minting is possible. Like an orchard that yields one harvest per season, growth is slow by design: the mesa of available identities stays low, so an attacker wanting ten thousand fakes must recruit ten thousand real people or wait years, while honest agents join cheaply through one verified check. A hollow identity with no person behind it simply cannot be created.
